note: The openavalon commit whose publish-librewpf-github-packages.yml run produced the LibreWPF/LibreWinForms/ProGPU packages this checkout consumes. openavalon republishes under the same version, so NuGet cannot tell two publishes apart: change this after a publish you want to take, and the CI package cache key and sync-openavalon-feed.ps1 both fetch the packages again.
